snippet.title: Leaf Town Demo Now Available
snippet.description:
The indie game Leaf Town demo is now live!
Leaf Town is an indie game combining farm management with roguelike gameplay, developed solely by me. The demo is now available on the Steam store.
If you're interested, feel free to try it for free and add it to your wishlist!
